entities.summary: Jean-Yves Leconte was a member of the Senate of France, representing the constituency of French citizens living abroad from 2011 to 2023. He is a member of the Socialist Party. Jean-Yves Leconte was a performers & entertainers from 12th arrondissement of Paris (b. 1966-10-31, 12th arrondissement of Paris). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
